title: Detailed crescent moon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='moonGlow' cx='38%' cy='38%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff8d6'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#ffe066'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#f0b429'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='halo' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe066' stop-opacity='0.35'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffe066' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- soft glow behind moon -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='50' r='46' fill='url(#halo)'/>

  <!-- crescent body: outer circle minus offset inner circle -->
  <path d='M 62 8
           A 42 42 0 1 0 62 92
           A 34 34 0 1 1 62 8 Z'
        fill='url(#moonGlow)'/>

  <!-- craters, lighter and darker shades of moon yellow -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='30' r='6' fill='#e8c04a'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='29' r='3.4' fill='#d9a93a'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='52' r='4.2' fill='#e8c04a'/>
  <circle cx='30.6' cy='51.4' r='2.3' fill='#d9a93a'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='70' r='5' fill='#e8c04a'/>
  <circle cx='44.8' cy='69' r='2.7' fill='#d9a93a'/>
  <circle cx='25' cy='38' r='2.6' fill='#e8c04a'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='82' r='2.8' fill='#e8c04a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='2.4' fill='#e8c04a'/>

  <!-- lit rim highlight on outer edge -->
  <path d='M 62 8 A 42 42 0 0 0 62 92'
        fill='none' stroke='#fffbe0' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.9'/>

  <!-- tiny stars -->
  <path d='M 82 22 l 1.6 4 4 1.6 -4 1.6 -1.6 4 -1.6 -4 -4 -1.6 4 -1.6 Z' fill='#fff2a8'/>
  <path d='M 78 70 l 1.2 3 3 1.2 -3 1.2 -1.2 3 -1.2 -3 -3 -1.2 3 -1.2 Z' fill='#fff2a8'/>
  <path d='M 88 48 l 1 2.5 2.5 1 -2.5 1 -1 2.5 -1 -2.5 -2.5 -1 2.5 -1 Z' fill='#fff2a8'/>
</svg>
